description: This file is a Python script that generates C++ code for Google Mock (GMock) mutants, including template classes and functions for mocking method calls with pre-bound and call-time arguments, as well as code for dispatching calls and creating functors.

classes.name: MutantRunner
classes.description: Interface for executing methods with parameters.

classes.name: Mutant
classes.description: Template class holding a pre-bound method and enabling call with parameters.

classes.name: MutantFunction
classes.description: Template class for wrapping free functions with pre-bound arguments.

classes.name: MutantLateObjectBind
classes.description: Template class for late binding of objects via pointer-to-pointer.

classes.name: MutantFunctor
classes.description: Wrapper that acts as a functor to invoke MutantRunner objects.

methods.name: DispatchToMethod
methods.description: Template function to invoke a method on an object with pre-bound and call-time arguments.

methods.name: DispatchToFunction
methods.description: Template function to invoke a free function with pre-bound and call-time arguments.

methods.name: CreateFunctor
methods.description: Template functions to create MutantFunctor objects for methods and functions.

methods.name: SplitLine
methods.description: Splits a line at a comma within a specified width.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Wraps a string at commas to a specified width.

methods.name: Clean
methods.description: Cleans artifacts from generated C++ code strings.

methods.name: ExpandPattern
methods.description: Replaces '%' in a pattern with elements from a list.

methods.name: Gen
methods.description: Generates a sequence of strings with sequential integers.

methods.name: GenAlpha
methods.description: Generates a sequence of strings with sequential lowercase letters.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Joins a list of strings with commas.

methods.name: GenTuple
methods.description: Creates a tuple type string with a specified number of elements.

methods.name: FixCode
methods.description: Formats code strings with line wrapping.

methods.name: GenerateDispatch
methods.description: Generates code for dispatching method calls with various argument bindings.

methods.name: GenerateCreateFunctor
methods.description: Generates code for creating functor objects with various argument bindings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that generates the entire C++ code for mutants and dispatch functions.
